facts.value: Brain estimates roughly 800 LAN and esports gaming centers operate nationally, from a web search; no directory or count of reachable managers has been compiled.
Sell Brain produces the workbook on payment; card payouts land 3 days after payment. to each buyer.
Managers of LAN and esports gaming centers
Six gaming-center managers paid $129 each for the workbook after a first outreach (payment-processor report, Nov 2026).

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN with MARKET_VOLUME as the decisive gap is right. Price $129 is a real purchase price for this buyer (six managers paid $129 each, payment-processor report); conversion 6/50 = 12% is measured on this offer; fulfilment, $2 cost, zero exposure and 3-day settlement are evidenced. Recomputed: $3,000 / ($129 - $2) = 23.6 -> 24 orders; 24 / 0.12 = 200 contacts beyond the 50 already used. The only buyer count is Brain's own ~800-center web-search estimate (a RECOMMENDATION fact, no directory compiled), so the reachable population is unknown and correctly not treated as known. The resolution (compile and count a directory of centers with published manager emails, then re-plan if >=200) is a research measurement, not a live test, so NO_PLAN rather than CONDITIONAL is correct; no step takes orders or spends.
findings: Buyer volume rests only on an estimate (RECOMMENDATION); an estimate is not evidence of ~200 reachable uncontacted managers.
Arithmetic checks: 24 orders, ~200 contacts at 12%, inside the 30-day window with 3-day settlement once the count exists.
Brain's MARKET_VOLUME basis says 14 deals while its question says 24; the plan's 24 matches the full $3,000 gap and is the conservative figure.
